question: A and B complete a work in 2 days. If A alone can do it in 38 days, then B alone can do 9-times of the same work in days.
solution:
**Given:**

A + B can do the work in 2 days

A alone can do the work in 38 days

Find: Time for B alone to do 9 times the work

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days taken

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Time = Total work ÷ Efficiency
